title: /sitPl
description: SitPL lets players sit anywhere on the server with a simple /sitpl command using an invisible ArmorStand.
body:
**SitPL** is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that adds a natural sitting mechanic to your server. With a single `/sitpl` command, players can sit down anywhere in the world — whether it's at a campfire, on a cliff edge, or inside their base.

The plugin spawns an **invisible, gravity-free ArmorStand** at the player's feet and mounts them onto it, creating a clean and immersive sitting effect. ArmorStands are **automatically removed** the moment a player dismounts by sneaking, and all chairs are safely cleaned up on server shutdown — no leftover entities, no lag.

Built with **Java 21** and the modern Paper API, SitPL works completely out of the box with no configuration required. Just drop it in your `plugins/` folder and you're good to go.

## ⌨️ Commands

| Command | Alias | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/sitpl` | `/sit` | all players | Sit down · run again to stand up |

## 🖥️ Compatibility

| Server Software | Version | Supported |
|---|---|---|
| Paper | 1.21 – 1.21.x | ✅ |
| Folia | 1.21 – 1.21.x | ✅ |
| Spigot | 1.21 – 1.21.x | ✅ |
| Purpur | 1.21 – 1.21.x | ✅ |
| CraftBukkit | 1.21 | ✅ |
